---
title: "MANTIS"
subtitle: "One quality-controlled chain, three packages"
format:
  biodiversaplus-revealjs:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        /* A figure slide is the figure. The message is a full sentence, so it
           is set as a running head rather than a display heading, and the
           figure takes the rest of the slide. */
        .reveal .figure-slide h2 {
          font-size: 1.05em; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 0.15em;
        }
        .reveal .figure-slide img {
          margin: 0; border: none; box-shadow: none; background: none;
        }
        </style>
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
for (f in c("profiles", "spec", "render", "checks", "document")) {
  source(file.path("R", paste0(f, ".R")))
}
specs <- document_specs()
```

```{r}
#| label: slides
#| output: asis
# One slide per figure, with the figure's own message as the slide title: if
# the message does not work as a title, the figure does not have one message.
for (spec in specs) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s {.figure-slide}\n\n", spec$message))
  cat(sprintf('![](%s){fig-alt="%s"}\n\n',
              figure_path(spec, "slide"), spec$alt))
}
```
